newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Huarte new shares to list on Aug 21.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Huarte new shares to list on Aug 21.

text.p: Spanish construction firm Huarte said on Tuesday new shares resulting from a capital expansion approved in June would be quoted on the Madrid and Barcelona stock exchanges from August 21.
The company said 10,015,657 new ordinary shares with a nominal value of 500 pesetas would be issued at a price premium of 145 pesetas.
The new issue raises Huarte's total number of listed shares to 34.4 million and brings share capital to 17.15 billion pesetas.
A shareholders' meeting approved a capital increase on June 19. A total of 786 creditors have underwritten more than 10 million shares for a value of more than five billion pesetas.

"This expansion has allowed the construction company to raise its shareholders' equity by 70 percent and the book value per share by 20 percent, giving an average cost of 865 pesetas per share subscribed for the underwriters," the company said in a statement.

Huarte said that with the expansion, which had been suggested by several of its creditors, 8.69 billion pesetas worth of loans had been reinvested. Of this total, 5.01 billion pesetas have been used to increase the nominal share capital and the rest has been used to boost reserves.
The troubled company suspended payments to suppliers last year after a rescue plan failed. It resumed payments and returned to business as usual at the beginning of this year.
